description: Per-process disk I/O monitor with disk write alerts, per-app network traffic, and NVMe health monitoring for Windows.
pre_install: if (-not $imagePathMatch.Success) { throw 'Could not resolve the existing FlowCat Collector executable path.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $oldServiceExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Existing FlowCat Collector executable not found: $oldServiceExe" }
if ($stopProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Could not stop FlowCat Collector before updating (exit code $($stopProcess.ExitCode))." }
post_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $serviceExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'FlowCatService.exe was not extracted from the Inno Setup package.' }
if ($installProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "FlowCat Collector service installation failed (exit code $($installProcess.ExitCode))." }
pre_uninstall: if ($uninstallProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "FlowCat Collector service removal failed (exit code $($uninstallProcess.ExitCode))." }
notes: Scoop extracts the Inno Setup payload directly; the vendor installer and its Start Menu / uninstall routines are not executed.
Installing, updating, and uninstalling registers, restarts, or removes the FlowCat Collector Windows service and requires UAC approval. The service binary remains inside the Scoop app directory.
Statistics and privacy settings are stored in %ProgramData%\FlowCatWindows and are retained when the Scoop app is uninstalled.
